name: Digital: A Love Story
tagline: A computer mystery/romance set five minutes into the future of 1988
blurb: A computer mystery/romance set five minutes into the future of 1988.
description:
A computer mystery/romance set five minutes into the future of 1988.

I can guarantee at least ONE of the following is a real feature:

• Discover a vast conspiracy lurking on the internet!

• Save the world by exploiting a buffer overflow!

• Get away with telephone fraud!

• HACK THE GIBSON!

Which one? You'll have to dial in and see. Welcome to the 20th century.

A pre-NaNoRenO release. Digital is released under a Creative Commons license. February 2010, by Christine Love.
